raw_hints: Use a square rectangular footprint roughly 9x9 blocks; center the structure inside a 11x11 shallow dug plot for the surrounding ground seen.
Build a 1-block high stone base course, then 3 rows of horizontal wood planks for the wall infill, with stone block columns at front corners interrupting the wood band.
Construct the roof as two concentric square frames of stone slabs: a lower outer slab layer projecting one block, then an inner slab layer and a 3x3 (approx) open hole in the center.
Leave the interior mostly open (air) visible through the roof opening; no visible windows — windowless facade except for a small recessed opening/gap on one side (uncertain).
rebuild_intent.summary: A small rectangular single-story structure with a raised stone-slab framed roof and a hollow central roof opening. Walls combine a lower stone base, middle horizontal wooden planks, and vertical stone corner/column blocks. Roof uses stacked stone slabs forming a double-layered frame with an inner hollow square. Building sits centered in a shallow dug foundation filled with coarse dirt (or podzol-like) ground.
